title: Synchronous blocking on futures or async results
summary: Blocking threads while waiting for asynchronous work in request or event-loop paths.
rationale: Blocking collapses concurrency and can force larger thread pools or longer tail latency.

detection.notes: Detect get(), wait(), join(), blocking waits, or condition variables in latency-sensitive paths.

impact.notes: Impact increases in hot paths, large inputs, high-concurrency services, build pipelines, or repeated request paths.

remediation.guidance: Propagate async composition, use continuations/coroutines, or isolate blocking work in bounded executors.
remediation.tradeoffs: Async refactors can be invasive; prioritize high-traffic boundaries.
